text: So keep three things apart. Intensity is physical, in watts per square metre. Intensity level is ten log I over I nought, in decibels. Loudness is a sensation, measured in phon or sone. A sound can be perfectly measurable and yet completely inaudible, like an ultrasonic whistle.
